Tools.River: Rivers and liquids (water, lava, poison, acid)
Tools.Paint: Paint terrain (a round brush: click to dab, drag to paint)
Tools.Door: Doors (click a wall to add a door, click a door to edit it)
Tools.Edit: Edit points (drag to move, Shift-drag a road or river point to set its width, right-click to delete)
Tools.Link: Link light switches (click a switch, then the lamps, rooms and lights it controls)
Tools.Stamp: Stamps (click the canvas to place the selected stamp)
Tools.Materials: Room materials (click a room to set its floor and walls)
Tools.Effects: Area effects (click painted ground or a room to set its movement cost and region behaviours)
Tools.Pin: Map pin (click to place a note, or click a pin to set what it shows and opens)
Tools.Label: Map label (click to place text on the map, or click a label to change it)
Tools.Zone: Zone (click to place a region in one of Foundry's shapes, or click a zone to reshape it or attach it to a token)
Tools.Generator: Map builder (compose a map from an intent, generate a floor plan, or build a scene spec)

Generator.IntentRefused: The map intent was not composed:

ComposeProblems.RoomsDoNotFit: {building}: its rooms do not fit a {width} × {height} footprint, so it was left out.
ComposeProblems.NotBeside: {building}: {room} could not be put beside {other}, so they are joined through other rooms.
ComposeProblems.NoStamp: {wantedIn}: no loaded stamp is a {role}, so none was placed.
ComposeProblems.Placeholder: {wantedIn}: no loaded stamp draws the {piece}, so a labelled box stands in for it.
ComposeProblems.NoRoom: {wantedIn}: there is no room for the {piece} where it was asked, so it was left off.
ComposeProblems.NoStairwell: {building}: its floors could not share a place for a stair, so they are not joined.
ComposeProblems.Borrowed: {wantedIn}: the map's settings have no way between levels, so {used} was borrowed from another setting.
ComposeProblems.StandIn: {wantedIn}: no loaded stamp is {wanted}, so {used} stands in.
ComposeProblems.BorrowedArt: {wantedIn}: the map's settings have no {role}, so one was borrowed from another setting.

Generator.Refused: The scene spec was not built:

Problems.Level: features.{index}: skipped, its level could not be created.
Problems.Stamp: features.{index}: skipped, its stamp is not in any loaded pack.
Problems.Interior: features.{index}: placed, but its interior could not be linked.
Problems.Switch: features.{index}: placed, but it is not a light switch, or something it controls is not a lamp, a room or a light.
Problems.Splat: splats.{index}: skipped, its mask is not an 8-bit RGBA or RGB PNG that can be read.

AssistEndpoint.Name: Map builder model: endpoint
AssistEndpoint.Hint: The OpenAI-compatible API the Map builder's AI-assisted mode asks, e.g. https://gateway.example/v1. It must be served over HTTPS and allow this world's address (CORS). Empty: the mode is off.

AssistModel.Name: Map builder model: model
AssistModel.Hint: The model the AI-assisted mode asks, as the endpoint names it (e.g. a Qwen model).

AssistKey.Name: Map builder model: key
AssistKey.Hint: The endpoint's API key, if it needs one. Kept in this browser only.

TextureSet.Name: Terrain texture set
TextureSet.Hint: Which asset-pack texture set fills biome regions, brush strokes, room floors and roads. Terrain without a texture in the set draws a procedural pattern in its colour.

StampSnap.Name: Snap placed stamps to the grid
StampSnap.Hint: Snap a placed stamp's top-left corner to the nearest grid intersection.

TerrainRegions.Name: Terrain as Scene Regions
TerrainRegions.Hint: Mirror each painted biome area and brush stroke as a Scene Region named after its biome, so region behaviours (difficult terrain, weather and so on) can be attached to it.

DropShadows.Name: Drop shadows
DropShadows.Hint: Draw a soft shadow beneath every standing stamp, falling away from the scene's sun (set by a game system's calendar through the module API, else a high north-western sun). None falls while the sun is down.

StampScale.Name: Stamp scale
StampScale.Hint: Multiplier over a stamp's authored grid footprint when it is placed (1 = authored size).
